movelist.name: Focus Energy
movelist.effect: The user becomes Pumped. While Pumped, the user’s Critical Range is extended by 2, or 18+ if the Critical Range is not otherwise extended. Being switched will cause this effect to end.

movelist.name: Scary Face
movelist.effect: The target’s Speed is lowered 2 Combat Stages.

movelist.name: Pursuit
movelist.effect: If the foe is fleeing or being switched out, Pursuit may be used as an Interrupt, targeting the triggering foe. When used as an Interrupt, Pursuit grants the user a +5 bonus to all Movement Speeds, and has a Damage Base of 8 (2d8+10 / 19).

movelist.name: Take Down
movelist.effect: You may perform a Trip Maneuver against the target as a Free Action.

abilities.name: Mold Breaker
abilities.effect: The user ignores the effect of enemies’ Defensive Abilities.

abilities.name: Sprint
abilities.effect: The user gains +2 Speed Combat Stages.
